Photo 1 shows packaging/manual inserts; no clear view of the camera model label or screen.
Photo 2 shows items packed in bubble wrap; the camera/lens are not clearly identifiable by model in this shot.

claims.evidence: Seller text claims D750, but the photos provided do not show readable D750 model text or a clear model/label view.
No close-up photos of body condition, sensor/mirror area, or lens glass under light.
Seller says it was tested, but no photo/video of power-on, menu use, autofocus, shutter actuation, or playback is provided.
No shutter count readout/screenshot is shown.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No close-up lens glass photos (front and rear) under angled light are provided.
No clear photos of battery/charger labels/models to confirm originality.
No service history, inspection evidence, or internal photos are provided.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be D750 (or could be a different Nikon DSLR body).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera showing the model name/label (or the 'About' screen after powering on).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unconfirmed Nikon DSLR body (worst case: not the claimed D750).

risks.risk: Camera may not be fully functional (shutter/sensor/AF/ports).
risks.proof: Power-on video: menu navigation + take a photo + playback; include a quick autofocus test on a nearby object.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be inaccurate.
risks.proof: Screenshot/photo of shutter count readout from a shutter count tool or the exact on-screen value.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as higher shutter wear (worst case: not under 5,000).

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus/haze/scratches not visible from current angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear glass at multiple angles with strong light; plus a test shot showing contrast/flare.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lens condition uncertain (worst case: possible fungus/haze/scratches).

risks.risk: Accessories may be non-original or incomplete.
risks.proof: Clear photos of battery and charger labels/models; show they are included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming accessories may be generic or incomplete.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage not captured in current photos.
risks.proof: Photos of camera body corners, mount area, and any dents/scratches; functional check of ports/hot shoe.

proof_requests: Power-on video showing: menu, taking a photo, and playback (date/time visible).
Close-up lens photos: front element and rear element (rear glass via mount side) under bright light at angles.
Clear photo of the camera model label (to confirm D750) and serial number area.
Photos of included battery and charger labels/models (to confirm originality) and that they are present.
response.reason: The seller’s reply asserts testing and truth, but without new photos/videos the key pricing drivers (exact model confirmation, shutter count, working status, and lens condition) remain unverified from the provided images. To avoid a confident wrong price, proof is required.
